description: With spread_mode strict, two copies or more of every file each need the small domain: it bounds the capacity, which the formula over the disks alone does not.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[placement]
spread_mode = "strict"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "a"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "a"
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t3"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "b"
